text: The Fed is now signaling a possible rate hike to ~4.2% amid sticky 3.4% CPI and war-driven inflation, with rate cuts pushed to 2027-2028 — this is a meaningful shift that raises the cost of holding speculative, cash-burning positions and could pressure growth stock valuations.
RGTI is down 43% and 72% off its high with declining revenue, cash burn, insider selling, and 18% short interest — the thesis is broken and this should be sold to stop further losses.

QBTS is down 38.5% and 62% off its high with no earnings, significant cash burn, and 22% short interest — in a rising-rate environment this speculative position has no margin of safety and should be exited.
IONQ is down nearly 20% and over 52% off its high with cash burn and 10% short interest — a third cash-burning quantum computing stock with no clear path to profitability should be sold.

NCLP.L is your worst-performing holding at down 22.7%, sitting 35% below its high with weakening momentum — trim this position to reduce risk since the REDUCE signal suggests the trend is deteriorating.
Micron at a PE of 6.5 with 49% revenue growth and strong technical momentum is the most compelling risk-reward in your portfolio — consider adding on any pullback toward support.
Adobe looks oversold at a PE of just 9 with solid 10.5% revenue growth and outstanding free cash flow yield — this is a quality name at a discount worth adding to.
Google at a PE of 23.5 with 15% revenue growth, strong free cash flow, and insider buying offers solid value in an uncertain macro environment — consider adding gradually.
